beats.headline: Sobered by force
beats.text: Mordecai hands each of the two men a white potion with a blank description. Louis downs his and is soon not drunk anymore, though he still feels sick. Firas is suspicious and asks why there is no description, but drinks. Soon both are on their hands and knees, scream-vomiting for minutes. It's called Rapid Detox, Mordecai tells Carl: it clears alcohol and most drugs, used to treat alcoholism and to torture prisoners. Sage beetle ichor hid the description. Louis gets a notification that he can't drink anymore.
